disclosures_auditor_report.auditor:
(a) The Company's internal financial controls with respect to information technology general controls relating to program change, logical access and manage change and integration amongst other IT applications were not operating effectively which could result in potential misstatement of account balances in the financial statements.

(b) The Company's internal financial controls with respect to year end financial statement closure process were not operating effectively as per documented procedures for such process in relation to reconciliation of related party transactions and balances, customers and vendors balances, identification and timely payment of MSME parties and other book closure adjustments which could potentially result in material misstatement in the Company's financial statement balances and presentation and disclosure of financial statements.

disclosures_director_report.auditor: Proper books of account have been maintained by the Company, except for one application operated through a third-party service provider. In the absence of a Service Organization Controls report, we are unable to verify whether daily backups were maintained on servers physically located in India, and other matters noted under Rule 11(g).
disclosures_director_report.director: As informed by HR Spine Payroll Management Software team, backup is taken by them on regular basis and the same is accessible by the Company as and when required by the Company. Alternatively, the Company is in process of exploring the options for resolving the issue in-house.

disclosures_director_report.auditor: Material weaknesses were identified in the Company's internal financial controls, including ineffective IT general controls over access and changes, and deficiencies in year-end closure processes (related party transactions and balances, customers and vendors balances, identification and timely payment of MSME parties), potentially causing misstatements in standalone financial statements.
disclosures_director_report.director:
The Board has considered the auditor's observations and confirms that corrective actions are being undertaken. 
a.	The Company is strengthening its IT controls, access management, and change processes to ensure accurate records. 
b.	A Related Party Transactions tracker will be maintained monthly as part of the closing checklist effective September 2025. 
c.	MSME payments are being made within due dates, except for disputed cases under resolution. 
d.	Going forward the Company will diligently obtain customer & Vendor balance confirmations.

disclosures_director_report.auditor: The auditors noted that In one of the applications used by the Company for maintenance of books of account, the audit trail feature was not enabled for certain access rights allowing direct data changes. The audit trail for prior years has, however, been preserved to the extent it was enabled and recorded as per statutory requirements.
disclosures_director_report.director: The audit trail feature in the said application was not enabled for certain user access levels due to system limitations. The Company has since initiated necessary corrective actions in consultation with the software service provider to ensure that the audit trail functionality is enabled for all relevant access rights going forward.

disclosures_director_report.auditor: The Company has maintained proper records showing full particulars, including quantitative details of Property, Plant and Equipment, except for certain class of assets where property, plant and equipment register is to be updated to include quantitative details and situation details thereof.
disclosures_director_report.director: The Board confirms that the Company has maintained proper records of Property, Plant and Equipment. The Fixed Asset Register has already been updated in the D365 software, and the Company is in the process of capitalizing all assets in the system in compliance with the requirements of Ind AS.
